description: This file contains shell functions for checking and repairing ext2, ext3, and ext4 filesystems using e2fsck, and logs the process results. It also appends filesystem types to a known filesystem check list.

methods.name: fsck_e2fsck
methods.description: Function to run e2fsck on a given device, handle different error statuses, and log outputs.

methods.name: fsck_ext2
methods.description: Wrapper function that calls fsck_e2fsck for ext2 filesystems.

methods.name: fsck_ext3
methods.description: Wrapper function that calls fsck_e2fsck for ext3 filesystems.

methods.name: fsck_ext4
methods.description: Wrapper function that calls fsck_e2fsck for ext4 filesystems.
